title: Faultline: the flight recorder for your API

lines.text: One coupon code. Every checkout that uses it dies with a five hundred. The agent you ask to fix it never saw the request, so you paste logs and guess.
Faultline. A flight recorder for your API, inside Hermes.
lines.say: Fault-line. A flight recorder for your A P I, inside Hermes.

lines.text: Hermes puts a proxy in front of the service. Every request and response is recorded. Secrets are redacted before anything touches disk.

The failing call is right there: a division by zero when the coupon makes the total zero. On a route that still returns two hundred, Faultline flags drift. Total cents became a string. Currency went missing.
lines.say: The failing call is right there: a division by zero when the coupon makes the total zero. On a route that still returns two hundred, Fault-line flags drift. Total cents became a string. Currency went missing.

lines.text: Hermes patches the code. Faultline replays the exact captured request. Five hundred becomes two hundred. Not a claim. A measurement.
lines.say: Hermes patches the code. Fault-line replays the exact captured request. Five hundred becomes two hundred. Not a claim. A measurement.

lines.text: Chaos rules inject rate limits and latency on demand. You learn how clients cope before production teaches you.
Faultline. A plugin for Hermes Agent. Record it. Prove it.
